result: All 14 finite frontier target Lean modules compile under Lean 4.35.0 with the pinned Mathlib, built through lake from the FrontierTargets library registered in lean4/lakefile.lean, one lake build invocation per module; every printed axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, with zero sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide or unsafe outside comments and strings.
proof_boundary: This receipt records that the 14 finite target modules type-check under Lean 4.35.0 and which axioms their #print axioms lines report. It does not record that a module states the whole of its node: the statement each node carries after the review in dag/research/frontier_targets_lean_review.md is the one these modules are checked against, and the review lists the parts that remain unproved for every narrowed node. External physical interpretations, continuum limits and asymptotic formulas remain outside these proofs.
